olivia (People Ops): Heads up: SF office will have scheduled power testing on Sat 2026-07-11 09:00-13:00. Building power will be cycled briefly during the window.

olivia (People Ops): What this means: short outages (a few seconds) and one planned ~15min outage at ~10:30 for the test. Please avoid scheduling critical demos or deploys during that window if you were planning to be onsite.

marc (Facilities): Backup UPS covers essential racks but some non-critical wall outlets/conference AV may reboot. Bring chargers and save work.

yana: I have an interview panel at 10:00. Can we move it to 14:00 or use the Zoom room?

olivia (People Ops): @yana We recommend moving to 14:00 or switching to the Red Oak Zoom room (it's on generator). If you need room booking help DM me.

drew: Any food carts vendors affected? We had to schedule lunch for interns that day.

marc (Facilities): @drew Catering can still drop off but no hot equipment will be plugged into building power during the 10:30 window. Suggest using insulated food carriers or bringing food that doesn't need on-site warming.

olivia (People Ops): Transit note: If you commute by bike, bike room access remains open. If you need reserved parking because of medical reasons, reply and we'll put you on the priority list Friday night.

calendar-bot: Event created: "SF - Power Testing (planned)" 2026-07-11.

olivia (People Ops): TL;DR: expect brief interruptions, avoid critical onsite events 10:15-11:00, DM for accommodations. Will post a final reminder 48h prior. :wave:
